title: DaakBaksher Gaan — 2D Sumi-e Wind Game

semver.schema_rule: vX.Y.Z — X: Feature Addition, Y: Bug Fix, Z: Additional

changelog.summary: Added Username + Created Password Authentication gating social media profile links, voluntary personal info, and Leaderboard visibility; implemented mobile UI touch/viewport fixes (6-word compact density, 44px touch targets, single-row landscape dock) and Zero-Client-Exposure privacy hardening.
X_feature_additions: Username + Created Password authentication system (registerUserAccount, loginUserAccount, submitUserAuth, logoutUserAccount) with salted SHA-256 / PBKDF2 password hashing
Authenticated access gate for entering social media links (#cert-step1-box) and voluntary personal info (#cert-step2-voluntary-box) in the 9:16 Certificate modal
Members-only Official Leaderboard gate (#leaderboard-auth-gate & /api/game-leaderboard) visible exclusively to logged-in users while displaying verified names and social profiles
Y_bug_fixes: Fixed mobile touch drag responsiveness with cached stage bounds, explicit releasePointerCapture, touch-action: none, and WCAG 44px touch targets

Implemented Option A adaptive word density (6 concurrent words on compact mobile <=420px wide or <=480px tall, 10 on desktop/tablet) and clamped initial mobile spawn X inside visible bounds away from the postbox
Fixed 844x390 landscape dock collision, 340x640 Completeness cell clipping, duplicate mobile HUD audio buttons, and repositioned #feedback-whisper to top of stage
Remediated client bundle privacy by stripping all internal notification email addresses, third-party relay tokens, and cloud document IDs from client HTML/JS and API responses
Z_additional: Added v4.0.0 Leaderboard version filter pill, top HUD account status button (#btn-user-auth), and honeypot anti-spam protection

changelog.summary: Fixed backend notification links by binding canonical public URLs (https://songs.abhikism.com/daakbaksher-gaan/game/), blocking local loopback Referer leakage, and adding server-side relay synchronization.
Y_bug_fixes: Fixed broken local loopback link in notification dispatches by setting canonical game URLs (https://songs.abhikism.com/daakbaksher-gaan/game/) and blocking direct browser calls from 127.0.0.1/localhost/file:
Added server-side authenticated notification relay and cloud sync so notifications arrive reliably
Z_additional: Added v3.1.0 Leaderboard version filter pill and clickable game_url / leaderboard_url links inside notification payloads

changelog.summary: YouTube Music embedded player looping by default with smart error detection fallback to Instant Web Audio, continuous autoplay by default, and exclusive Mute/Unmute + Play from Beginning (0:00) controls (zero Stop/Pause).
X_feature_additions: YouTube Music embedded player (8K1B2qG3U7E) active and looping by default via YouTube IFrame API with automatic loop-on-end and auto-resume-on-pause enforcement

Smart audio error detection (smartDetectAudioErrorAndFallback / window.triggerSmartAudioErrorFallback) detecting YT.Player onError events, iframe API script blocks, offline states, and watchdog timeouts to seamlessly switch to Instant Web Audio fallback (daakbaksher-gaan.m4a)
Continuous default song playback with only Mute/Unmute (#btn-mute-toggle, #btn-dock-mute) and Play from Beginning 0:00 (#btn-restart-song, #btn-dock-restart) options and zero Stop/Pause controls
Y_bug_fixes: Prevented dual-audio track overlap by keeping Instant Web Audio fallback silenced while YouTube Music primary loop is active
Added transparent click-shield over embedded YouTube surface and pause-interception guard on fallback Web Audio so playback can never be stopped
Z_additional: Added v3.0.0 Leaderboard version filter pill and updated version_manifest.json across all 14 deployment targets

changelog.summary: 5 automatic wind levels (5->15->25->50->125 words), live HUD & certificate timer, official Leaderboard with version/level/timing tags, and Completeness telemetry.
X_feature_additions: 5-level automatic progression system (5 -> 15 -> 25 -> 50 -> 125 target words) with automatic windspeed scaling (1.0x -> 1.35x -> 1.75x -> 2.20x -> 2.75x) and zero manual controls
Live high-precision game timer (#hud-timer, MM:SS.d) displayed in HUD and stamped on the 9:16 Story Certificate
Leaderboard system (#leaderboard-modal & /api/game-leaderboard) with version winner tags, timing tags, and level info tags
Mandatory semantic game versioning (vX.Y.Z) enforced at build time and displayed across HUD, 9:16 Certificate, Leaderboard, and server telemetry
Y_bug_fixes: Unified all progress UI and certificate wording around Complete / Completeness
Cleaned up track metadata badges across game HUD, player dock, 9:16 certificate canvas, and arcade hub
Enforced level-completion gate on advanceToNextLevel() and certificate issuance so levels and wind speeds cannot be manually skipped
Added visibilitychange timer pause/resume lifecycle and fresh elapsed-time snapshot on final word drop
Unified Leaderboard ranking comparator (Level DESC, Score DESC, Fastest Time ASC, Timestamp ASC, CertID ASC) and HTML-escaped player fields
Z_additional: Added level-advance workflow in completion modal and seeded canonical leaderboard winners across versions

changelog.summary: Initial 2D Sumi-e wind game with 125 canonical song words, 250 decoy words, Bengali <-> Roman toggle, and 9:16 certificate.
X_feature_additions: Initial 2D Sumi-e wind game with 125 canonical song words and 250 decoy words
Bengali <-> Roman Bengali live script toggle and 9:16 listener certificate with multi-platform social handle validation
